MuseEncore

v__VERSION__

MuseScore Studio's engraving engine, ported to TypeScript. Open, edit and play scores right in your browser, with no install.

Start composing Create and edit scores, play them back and save .mscz files. Open the editor View a score Open a .mscz or .mscx file and read it like a sheet of paper. Open the viewer Embed scores Put scores on your own web page with npm i muse-encore-viewer. See the example
Source code on GitHub
